entries.basis: Actual browser engine interactions cover pointer/touch input, focus, layout, portals and clipboard. Accepted trusted emulated-touch evidence satisfies the original browser-interaction criterion and the user's simulation preference; DOM-emulation is not used as its sole evidence, and no physical-device result is claimed.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-X-09 Reconcile original `X-09`: Test real browser interaction, including pointer/touch, focus, layout, portals and clipboard; DOM-emulation tests alone are insufficient. Historical status: open.

limits: Retained cases stay at their original source/runtime; no whole-parent green, physical touch, spoken AT or universal clipboard-policy assertion.
